prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Northeast US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania)?
response_text:
When seeking reputable residential pest control services in the Northeast U.S., particularly in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, consider the following companies:

**[Viking Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Viking+Pest+Control%2C+Basking+Ridge%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Basking Ridge, NJ_
With over 45 years of experience, Viking offers eco-friendly, science-backed treatments across NJ, PA, DE, and MD. They provide residential protection plans covering various pests and utilize SMART digital monitoring technology for 24/7 pest detection.

**[All Platinum Termite & Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/All+Platinum+Termite+%26+Pest+Control%2C+Staten+Island%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Staten Island, NY_
A family-owned business servicing the Tri-state area, including NY, NJ, and PA. They offer same-day service with affordable rates and no contracts, using low-toxic, organic, environmentally friendly products.

**[Rest Easy Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Rest+Easy+Pest+Control%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
Serving NY, NJ, and PA since 2012, Rest Easy boasts over 2,500 Google reviews with a 4.9 rating. They offer comprehensive residential pest control services with free quotes and same-day service.

**[Cooper Pest Solutions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Cooper+Pest+Solutions%2C+Lawrenceville%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Lawrenceville, NJ_
Founded in 1955, Cooper serves NJ and parts of PA. They are recognized for developing new pest treatment technologies and offer services for both residential and commercial clients.

**[Horizon Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Horizon+Pest+Control%2C+Midland+Park%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Midland Park, NJ_
A family-owned business since 1970, Horizon provides residential pest control services in NJ and NY. They offer the Home Guard Program, covering over 40 common household pests with seasonally scheduled services.

**[Superior Pest Elimination](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Superior+Pest+Elimination%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
With over 22 years of experience, Superior offers same-day pest control services in NY and NJ. They use reduced-risk products and provide various pest control plans tailored to different needs.

**[BHB Pest Elimination](https://www.google.com/maps/search/BHB+Pest+Elimination%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
Serving NYC since 1969, BHB provides residential and commercial pest control services. They offer customized extermination tailored to specific needs and have a strong reputation in the community.

**[Standard Pest Management](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Standard+Pest+Management%2C+Queens%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Queens, NY_
Established in 1929, Standard offers comprehensive residential pest control services throughout NYC, Westchester County, and Long Island. They provide monthly and quarterly pest management programs.

When selecting a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and commitment to environmentally friendly practices. It's advisable to contact multiple providers to discuss your specific needs and obtain quotes before making a decision.
